title: Members who borrowed five or more genres
statementMd:
List members who borrowed books from at least five different genres. Show name and genre count.

Expected columns: `name`, `genres`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.name, COUNT(DISTINCT b.genre) AS genres FROM members m JOIN loans l ON l.member_id = m.id JOIN books b ON b.id = l.book_id GROUP BY m.id, m.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT b.genre) >= 5;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
